items.title: Abandonment Next: Zinat Hirji — overdue for auto-abandon
items.summary: Zinat Hirji has carried stale_lead for a while and is now at 259.9 days in Postponed (144% of the 180-day, 2x-threshold auto-abandon point) yet remains open with a $14,000 value — one cycle+ past where the documented rule should have already abandoned it automatically.

items.title: Meeting No Followup: 14 opportunities idle since their visit, ~$140K
items.summary: 14 open Meeting-Scheduled opportunities (~$139,875 combined value) have had no visible activity since their appointment (32-156 days since the visit) — there is still no follow-up sequence for this stage, so once the visit passes, nothing pushes contact again until the 30-day stale clock runs out.

items.title: Meeting No Followup: Silviya Jardany — window expired before visit
items.summary: Silviya Jardany's visit was booked 39.1 days after she entered Meeting-Scheduled — past the 30-day threshold itself, leaving an effective_window_days of -9.1. She would be tagged stale before anyone could have followed up after the visit; this is a workflow-timing bug, not a rep failure. 30.7 days have passed since her visit with no further activity.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 210 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just this window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 210 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). One contact (noel brillantes) carries both lead: hot AND lead: warm simultaneously on different opportunities for the same person — a tag-conflict flagged in stragglers_ranked, so tag counts don't sum exactly.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the same bulk-import batch (frozen since the Oct 2025 pipeline launch) and a handful of 200+ day Postponed records. All figures grew consistently from the 2026-08-14 run (e.g. Cold 255.2->267.2 days over the 15-day gap), which cross-checks the pull.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Continues growing from the 2026-08-14 figures (open 216->261, won 304->309, abandoned 1225->1288).
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 51 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (66 total, lifetime). No store wins this window. No stale thresholds defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence).

meeting_window_summary.window_already_expired_note: Silviya Jardany: appointment booked 39.1 days after stage entry, past the 30-day threshold itself (effective_window_days = -9.1). A full per-contact appointment sweep succeeded for 23/24 this run (up from 3/21 on 08-14 and 10/41 on 08-08) by matching calendar events by contactId across both booking users.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Checked all 75 open, project-pipeline opportunities tagged 'mobile quote' against the full 265-conversation window sweep; 20 had zero visible activity in the last 15 days, of which 3 (Paresh Bhatt, Abdul Durrani, Penny Chan) are reported as followup_not_fired since they are not already stale_lead-tagged. The other 17 overlap with stale_approaching/meeting_no_followup/abandonment_next findings above.
reporting.tag_conflict_note: noel brillantes carries both lead: hot AND lead: warm simultaneously across two open opportunities (0a. New Lead and 0b. Later Date (Warm)) for the same contact — reported as a straggler, not corrected.
reporting.resolved_since_last_report: Jonathan Spence and Ricardo Mendoza (both flagged unanswered/unreadable in the 08-14 report) show outbound-last activity now — resolved sometime in the gap. Sabrina Agard's Oakville win from before this window continued smoothly. Basil Felix Da Souza and Sowmya, both flagged stuck/needing attention on 08-14, have now progressed: Basil closed WON and Sowmya is on an active 2nd project. Tina Tran's Lead-Qualification opportunity (flagged 08-14 for the undocumented 'abandoned-stale' tag) was finally marked Lost on 08-24 — but her separate Sales-Pipeline Meeting-Scheduled opportunity with the same tag remains open and is now even more stale (108.9 days).
reporting.ingest_gap_note: Last successful GHL ingest was 2026-08-14. Per instructions, this run widened the pull window to the full ~15-day gap rather than the standard 24h, covering all leads/opportunities/appointments/conversations from 2026-08-14T08:46:33-04:00 onward.
